title: dose.unit_mg output
description: Per unit, in order: the mg/g its mg TPE is worked out from (the lot's TPE, else the state's psilocybin; null: none, or a figure that can't be read) and its mg TPE, weightPerUnit x that mg/g rounded up to a whole mg, ceil(x - 1e-9) (null: unknown, or a product that isn't finite or fits no 64-bit integer).
